assertions.name: radical_pairing_equals_sign_rep_value_on_every_word
assertions.source: max over 13 braid words (writhe -3..+3) of |<v,nf> - (-1/q)^writhe| = 1.33638e-51 at 50 dps. The words include both SDP anchors, a pure-positive tower, a pure-negative one, and a writhe-0 commutator that is not the identity word — so the match is not an artefact of vanishing writhe.

assertions.name: pairing_never_vanishes_so_Gx_eq_nf_is_unsatisfiable_for_every_braid
assertions.source: min |<v,nf>| over the 13 words = 0.731234, and structurally it is a zpow of -1/q, which is nonzero for q != 0 at every integer exponent (QOU.QBeta.signRepValue_ne_zero). Since G is symmetric with kernel span(v), its range is v-perp, so G x = nf is solvable iff the pairing vanishes — it never does. The obstruction is universal, not anchor-specific.

assertions.name: writhe_grading_is_what_makes_it_a_framing_quantity
assertions.source: the pairing depends on the braid word ONLY through its writhe (7 distinct writhes among the 13 words; e.g. `s1 s2` and `s1^2` both have writhe 2 and pair identically). Writhe is exactly the grading the Ocneanu trace does not carry — invariance needs a writhe prefactor outside the trace — so the unreachable component is a framing quantity, which is why no re-solve inside the trace can recover it.

description: The convention-D Gram radical (the q-antisymmetriser) pairs with any braid's H_3(q) normal form to give exactly that braid's value in the one-dimensional SIGN representation: <v, nf(beta)> = (-1/q)^writhe(beta), measured over 13 braid words spanning writhe -3..+3, exact to 1.3e-51 at 50 dps. `-1/q` is the antisymmetric eigenvalue of the Hecke relation and the q-antisymmetriser is its projector, so this is what the radical IS rather than a basis artefact. CONSEQUENCE: G is symmetric with kernel spanned by v, so G x = nf is solvable iff <v,nf> = 0, and a zpow of a nonzero base never vanishes — therefore G x = nf is UNSATISFIABLE FOR EVERY BRAID, not merely for the two anchors of qbeta_braid_nf_sdp_offset_probe whose premise ('G is invertible (rank 6)') this refutes. No other knot escapes it. Lean, sorry-free, generic Field: signRepValue_append (multiplicative, from writhe_append), signRepValue_inv (mirror inverts it, from writhe_inv, and needs no q != 0), signRepValue_ne_zero, and radical_pairing_ne_zero_of_sign_rep. The unreachable component is graded by WRITHE — precisely what the Ocneanu trace does not see (invariance needs a writhe prefactor outside the trace, Jones 1987 Sec. 5) and what convention D's pin kills outright (conventionD_kills_antisymmetriser). SCOPE: does NOT re-pose the SDP on the quotient and reports no offset angle; that would answer a question with no solution in the form asked. No value wired, no tier moved, D stays canonical.
